# Copilot review instructions

- Treat `main` as the production branch. Pull requests into `main` must come from `dev`.
- Flag lint, type, build, accessibility, broken-link, and mobile-layout regressions.
- Pay special attention to keyboard navigation, readable contrast, responsive spacing, and descriptive link labels.
- Do not suggest adding secrets, credentials, analytics trackers, or paid services without an explicit project decision.
- Keep the site fast, simple, and easy to maintain for future club officers.
